//: postvec-server configuration, read by the packaged unit (--config /etc/postvec-server/config.json). Every key is optional and has a default; unknown keys are a hard error. Keys beginning with // are comments. Precedence: defaults < this file < environment < flags. Every key, explained: /usr/share/doc/postvec-server/postvec-server.example.json
//peers: Bare hosts of the other nodes in this fleet, e.g. ["10.0.0.11", "10.0.0.12"]. Leave empty for a single node.
//ssl: Certificate pair for the discovery listener. The packaged unit runs as the postvec-server account with /opt/postvec read-only and root-owned, so the pair lives here, beside this file: install the key as root:postvec-server, mode 0640 (see /usr/share/doc/postvec-server/README.md). Without a readable pair the node refuses to start — set "insecure": true only for local development.
